topic: The Triangle of Power: A Unified Notation for Powers, Roots, and Logarithms
target_audience: High school students and math enthusiasts

sections.title: The Fragmented Kingdom: The Problem with Current Notation
lecture_lines: Exponents, roots, and logarithms often feel like separate languages.
But these three operations are actually deeply connected siblings.
Our current notation hides this beautiful mathematical symmetry.
animations: Show '2³=8', '∛8=2', and 'log₂8=3' in different colors (#ADD8E6, #90EE90, #FFB6C1) scattered on screen.
Highlight '2³=8' in the center while other expressions fade slightly.
Highlight '∛8=2' in the center while other expressions fade slightly.
Highlight 'log₂8=3' in the center while other expressions fade slightly.
Character 'Leo' (yellow circle #FFFFE0) appears looking confused by three white puzzle boxes (#FFFFFF).

sections.title: Prerequisite Map: The Three Pillars
lecture_lines: Every power relationship involves a base and an exponent.
Multiplying the base repeatedly gives us the final result.
These three values form the foundation of our triangle.
animations: Display 'Base: 2' in blue (#0000FF) alongside a single 3D-looking cube [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cube.svg].
Display 'Exponent: 3' in green (#00FF00) as the cube [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cube.svg] multiplies into a 2x2x2 block.
Display 'Result: 8' in red (#FF0000) as a label for the completed 8-cube block made of multiple cubes [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cube.svg].

sections.title: Introducing the Triangle of Power
lecture_lines: Meet the Triangle of Power: a unified mathematical map.
The base sits at the bottom-left vertex.
The exponent climbs to the top peak.
The final result rests at the bottom-right vertex.
One single shape replaces three different notations.
animations: Draw a white (#FFFFFF) equilateral triangle outline centered on the screen.
Place '3' (Base) at the bottom-left vertex in blue (#0000FF) with a brief glow.
Place '2' (Exponent) at the top vertex in green (#00FF00) with a brief glow.
Place '9' (Result) at the bottom-right vertex in red (#FF0000) with a brief glow.
The entire triangle pulses with a soft white light (#FFFFFF) to show the unified relationship.

sections.title: Operation 1: The Power (Top-Down View)
lecture_lines: To find a power, look from base to exponent.
Five raised to the power of two equals twenty-five.
The result flows naturally to the bottom-right corner.
animations: Show the triangle with '5' (blue, #0000FF) at bottom-left and '2' (green, #00FF00) at the top vertex.
Animate a yellow glowing arrow (#FFFF00) flowing from the Base and Exponent toward the Result vertex.
Reveal '25' (red, #FF0000) at the bottom-right vertex with a scaling and flash effect.

sections.title: Operation 2: The Root (Right-to-Left View)
lecture_lines: Finding a root means searching for the missing base.
We move from the result back to the start.
The triangle unifies radicals into this simple structure.
animations: Show the triangle with '64' (red, #FF0000) at bottom-right and '3' (green, #00FF00) at the top vertex.
Animate a yellow glowing line (#FFFF00) tracing back from the Result and Exponent toward the Base vertex.
Reveal '4' (blue, #0000FF) at the bottom-left vertex with a scaling and flash effect.

sections.title: Operation 3: The Logarithm (Side-Climb View)
lecture_lines: Logarithms ask what exponent connects the base and result.
We climb the side to find the top value.
Ten cubed is one thousand, so the exponent is three.
animations: Show the triangle with '10' (blue, #0000FF) at bottom-left and '1000' (red, #FF0000) at the bottom-right vertex.
Animate a yellow line (#FFFF00) 'climbing' from the bottom edge up to the Exponent peak.
Reveal '3' (green, #00FF00) at the top vertex with a scaling and flash effect.

sections.title: Summary: The Unified Harmony
lecture_lines: The Triangle of Power reveals the harmony in math.
No more switching between confusing symbols and rules.
One mental map simplifies your mathematical journey.
animations: Rotate the Triangle of Power slowly with numbers 2, 3, and 8 on its vertices.
Flash the vertices in sequence to emphasize looking at the relationship from different angles.
Fade out the traditional symbols √, log, and ^ as they drift away from the triangle.
The triangle edges glow bright white (#FFFFFF) signifying the 'Unified Harmony'.
Leo the Lion (yellow circle, #FFFFE0) appears next to the triangle, jumping happily.
